mechanism: Primidone induces CYP450 enzymes (particularly CYP3A4 and CYP2C9) which may increase primaquine metabolism and reduce antimalarial efficacy, while primaquine may inhibit metabolism of primidone increasing seizure risk.
action: Monitor primaquine efficacy and primidone levels; consider alternative antimalarial if seizure control becomes problematic or use higher primaquine dosing with close clinical monitoring.
